description: Defines a template class 'WindowedFilter' implementing Kathleen Nichols' algorithm for tracking min/max estimates over a time window, used in congestion control within QUIC protocol.

classes.name: quic::WindowedFilter
classes.description: A template class for maintaining min or max estimates over a sliding time window, with methods to update, reset, and retrieve estimates.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Incorporates a new sample into the filter, updating estimates and expiring old samples.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all estimates to a new sample and timestamp.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets estimates to initial zero values.
